import json, subprocess, sys
MAIN='/workspace/submission/main.py'
def run(reqs):
    payload=b'\n'.join(json.dumps(r).encode() for r in reqs)+b'\n'
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I',MAIN], input=payload, capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode==0, p.stderr[:1000]
    return [json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.split(b'\n') if x]

def bits_runs(nbits, runs, extra):
    svcs = ['t%d'%i for i in range(nbits)] + ['a','b','c'] + ['u%d'%i for i in range(extra)]
    at = [{'op':'contains','path':['t%d'%i]} for i in range(nbits)]
    for tok,ln in runs:
        at.append({'op':'contains','path':[tok]*ln})
    return svcs, at

cases=[]
# A: dead branch (and with false) but 20480 tuples -> must be E_COMPLEXITY
svcs, at = bits_runs(7, [('a',16),('b',16),('c',9)], 14)
cases.append({'services':svcs,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':[{'op':'false'}]+at}}],'queries':[]})
# B: same but 19968 tuples -> ok, one state
svcs, at = bits_runs(7, [('a',16),('b',16),('c',8)], 14)
cases.append({'services':svcs,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':[{'op':'false'}]+at}}],'queries':[]})
# C: unreachable or-branch, 20480 tuples -> E_COMPLEXITY
svcs, at = bits_runs(7, [('a',16),('b',16),('c',9)], 14)
cases.append({'services':svcs,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'or','args':[{'op':'true'}]+at}},
                                      {'action':'drop','when':{'op':'and','args':at}}],'queries':[]})
# D: atoms only in a drop rule, allow is constant true, 20480 tuples -> E_COMPLEXITY
cases.append({'services':svcs,'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'true'}},
                                       {'action':'drop','when':{'op':'and','args':at}}],'queries':[]})
# E: empty everything
cases.append({'services':[],'rules':[],'queries':[]})
# F: empty services with queries [[]]
cases.append({'services':[],'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':[]}}],'queries':[[]]})
# G: not(contains(long))
cases.append({'services':['a','b'],'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'not','arg':{'op':'contains','path':['a']*16}}}],
              'queries':[[],['a']*15,['a']*16,['b']+['a']*15,['a']*15+['b']]})
out = run(cases)
for i,(c,o) in enumerate(zip(cases,out)):
    if o.get('ok'):
        print(i, 'ok states=%d accept=%s dist=%s queries=%s' % (
            len(o['dfa']['accept']), o['dfa']['accept'][:6], o['dfa']['distance'][:6],
            [(q['state'],q['allow'],q['distance']) for q in o['queries']]))
    else:
        print(i, o['error'])
